entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdellah Guennoun was an influential Moroccan writer, essayist, poet, academic, administrator, journalist, and faqīh who was born in Fes and died in Tangier. He was one of the leaders of the Nahda movement in Morocco, and served as the general secretary of the League of Moroccan Religious Scholars.
